description: This file defines types, constants, and functions related to concept vocabulary processing, including concept tag classification, token normalization, and script coverage analysis.

methods.name: classifyConceptTagScript
methods.description: Classifies a concept tag into script family: latin, cjk, mixed, or other.

methods.name: deriveConceptTags
methods.description: Generates concept tags from a file path and snippet, limited by a maximum count.

methods.name: summarizeConceptTagScriptCoverage
methods.description: Summarizes script coverage across multiple concept tags entries.
